9.1.2 Frame transmission in slave nodes
This section is only applicable to LIN slave nodes.
The following use case (Figure 9.3) shows the transmission of a LIN frame.
After
a received LIN header is indicated by the LIN driver, the PID is evaluated (shown by
function EvaluatePID). If it’s determined to belong to a transmission frame, the trans-
mission response data is requested from upper layer. The buffer to which SduPtr
member in PduPtr parameter points to can be directly passed to let the upper layer
copy the transmission data to the provided buffer. The LIN interface informs the driver
about the response type by setting the appropriate members of PduPtr (shown by
function SetPduPtrValues).
The CopyBuffer call is to show that the copying of the SDU is made in the LIN Driver
and not in the LIN Interface.
